title: Angular Conditional Distillation: Overcoming Classifier Geometry Mismatch
abstract: arXiv:2611.23941v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classifier outputs provide a fundamental and univer- sally available knowledge interface for knowledge distil- lation (KD). However, standard logit objectives entangle transferable semantic relations with architecture-dependent parameterization artifacts, causing a classifier geometry mismatch that makes direct knowledge transfer unreliable. To address this, we propose Angular Conditional Distilla- tion (ACD). First, the Angular Coordinate Interface (ACI) reconstructs the student classifier using angular coordi- nates, suppressing magnitude and bias effects to provide a geometry-compatible space. Then, Scale-Invariant Condi- tional Distillation (SICD) standardizes outputs and exclu- sively transfers conditional non-target relations, filtering out untransferable absolute confidence. Together, ACI de- fines where to transfer, while SICD defines what to transfer. Extensive experiments show that ACD achieves state-of-the- art performance o

translated_title: 角度条件蒸馏：克服分类器几何失配
translated_abstract: 分类器输出为知识蒸馏（KD）提供了一种基础且普遍可用的知识接口。然而，标准的logit目标函数将可迁移的语义关系与依赖于架构的参数化伪影纠缠在一起，导致分类器几何失配，使得直接的知识迁移不可靠。为解决这一问题，我们提出了角度条件蒸馏（ACD）。首先，角度坐标接口（ACI）使用角度坐标重建学生分类器，抑制幅度和偏置的影响，从而提供一个几何兼容的空间。随后，尺度不变条件蒸馏（SICD）对输出进行标准化，并仅迁移条件性非目标关系，过滤掉不可迁移的绝对置信度。二者结合，ACI定义了在哪里迁移，而SICD定义了迁移什么。大量实验表明，ACD实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出角度条件蒸馏（ACD），通过角度坐标接口（ACI）构建几何兼容空间、并用尺度不变条件蒸馏（SICD）仅迁移条件性非目标关系，从而克服分类器几何失配问题，实现最先进的知识蒸馏性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Angular Conditional Distillation (ACD), which overcomes classifier geometry mismatch by using the Angular Coordinate Interface (ACI) to provide a geometry-compatible space and Scale-Invariant Conditional Distillation (SICD) to transfer only conditional non-target relations, achieving state-of-the-art knowledge distillation performance.
